content.caption: ミィバオ、ついに伝説の巨大モンスター（実はただの落ち葉）と対峙！勇気ある一歩の先に待っていたのは、まさかの転倒でした。🐾
content.scene: A hand-painted book illustration of Mimibao, a tiny brown tabby kitten with hazel eyes and a white chin, lunging heroically toward a single dried autumn leaf on a sunlit wooden floor. She is mid-air in a clumsy pounce, limbs slightly splayed, showing a look of intense determination before an inevitable tumble.
content.topic: A brave kitten's dramatic battle against a fallen leaf.
